title: Claude Cowork pricing: plans, limits and the rename
h1: claude cowork pricing: what are you paying for?
description: Compare Claude Free, Pro, Max and Ultra prices, see where Cowork is included, and separate the plan price from usage and other services.
answer: claude cowork has no separate add-on price: anthropic includes it in paid claude plans. as of 12 november 2026, pro is $20 a month with monthly billing, max is $100 and ultra is $200, before tax. free does not include cowork. anthropic now describes cowork and chat as one claude, so you may see the cowork name less often.[^1][^2][^3]
og_line: the plan price, the limits, the name.

table.h: claude consumer plans as of 12 november 2026
table.intro: usd, before tax. cowork is included in paid plans, with no separate cowork price.[^1][^2]

sections.h: cowork is part of the claude plan
sections.md:
anthropic lists cowork on pro, max, ultra, team and enterprise. the consumer prices in the table are from the claude pricing page, checked on 12 november 2026. these are us dollar prices and exclude tax. anthropic's pages we read give no per-seat price for team or enterprise, so the table leaves those out.[^1][^2]

pro's annual option is shown as $17 a month with $200 paid up front. that is an annual commitment, not a $17 month-to-month checkout. max and ultra figures here are the monthly prices in the source; no annual discount is assumed. check the checkout and provider terms before paying.

sections.h: the rename does not create a second product bill
sections.md:
anthropic's product page now says cowork and chat are one claude. when work calls for files, claude brings in cowork automatically. read that as the current presentation of the feature, not evidence of a separate cowork purchase.[^3]

older articles may discuss a distinct cowork tab or use the old name throughout. when comparing a tutorial with your account, check its date and the present feature name. the [windows and linux guide](/guides/claude-cowork-windows) covers current platform support so you do not choose a plan based on an outdated mac-only description.

sections.h: the larger plan is about more than the sticker price
sections.md:
the current pricing record lists max at $100 and ultra at $200. it no longer lists a $200 max 20x tier under that name. max is described as 5x pro usage; ultra as 10x pro weekly usage, with no five-hour limit for verified accounts. do not turn those descriptions into a promise of unlimited work.[^2]

before upgrading, write down the task you cannot complete on the smaller plan. a higher allowance will not fix a brief that is missing the source files or a connection that cannot perform the action you need. choose for the actual constraint rather than the largest number on the page.

claude code cloud scheduled tasks, previously called routines, count against plan usage. they are available on pro, max, ultra, team and enterprise, with a minimum cloud interval of one hour. they run on anthropic-managed infrastructure, so a closed laptop does not stop them.[^4]

that is a separate question from what cowork costs. if your buying decision is mainly about recurring work, read [claude code scheduled tasks](/guides/claude-code-routines) and distinguish code tasks from cowork tasks before paying. a feature being included does not mean every frequency or workflow is available without limits.

sections.h: compare the costs of the workflow you want
sections.md:
list the ai plan, any separately purchased service, and where the work must run. do not count a desktop app price as if it also pays the ai provider. in dusk bot, ai usage is billed by your ai provider on your plan with them and is never on the dusk bill.[^5]

the [cowork alternative guide](/alternatives/claude-cowork) helps compare that different arrangement. dusk bot is free for personal use on your own computer; work use needs a work license. hosted dusk cloud has its own price. compare the parts you will actually need, including licensing, rather than calling the whole arrangement free because one part is.[^5]

faq.q: is claude cowork free or paid?
faq.a: paid. anthropic lists it on pro, max, ultra, team and enterprise, rather than free. there is no separate cowork add-on price in the cited plan information.[^1]

faq.q: is the $200 claude plan still max?
faq.a: the pricing page checked on 12 november 2026 calls the $200 monthly tier ultra. max is listed at $100 a month. prices exclude tax.[^2]

faq.q: do i pay extra because cowork is becoming claude?
faq.a: the current product page describes cowork and chat as one claude. the documented access is still through paid plans; there is no separate rename fee in the cited facts.[^1][^3]
